article.title: Dallas travels to Indiana for non-conference matchup
article.linkText: Dallas travels to Indiana for non-conference matchup
article.story: Dallas Mavericks (0-1, ninth in the Western Conference) vs. Indiana Pacers (1-0, seventh in the Eastern Conference) Indianapolis; Friday, 7 p.m. EDT BOTTOM LINE: Indiana and Dallas meet in non-conference action. Indiana went 19-63 overall last season while going 11-30 at home. The Pacers gave up 120.4 points per game while committing 20.9 fouls last season. Dallas finished 26-56 overall, 14-37 in Western Conference action and 10-31 on the road last season. The Mavericks allowed opponents to score 119.6 points per game and shoot 47.8% from the field last season. INJURIES: Pacers: Aaron Nesmith: out (hamstring), Johnny Furphy: out for season (acl), T.J. McConnell: out (hamstring). Mavericks: Tarik Biberovic: out (heel), Caleb Martin: out (thumb), Jett Howard: out (calf), Dereck Lively II: out (foot), Santi Aldama: out (knee). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
